name: Ray Projection via Multiple-Write Bus
definition: A projection mechanism that exploits a special common bus, the Voxel Multiple-Write Bus (VMWB), to select the non-transparent voxel closest to the observer along a ray. It uses $n$ identical processing units, one for each voxel in the beam.
summary: Ray Projection via Multiple-Write Bus is a hardware mechanism that selects the closest non-transparent voxel in logarithmic time by racing processing units against a dedicated bus.
